facts.fact: INTIC says Decree 67/2017 of 1 December approved Mozambique's E-Government Interoperability Framework, which is now under revision with EU support.

facts.fact: INTIC chair Lourino Chemane said on 13 October 2025 that revision of Decree 67/2017 is under way, with EU support, to add technical specifications, technical data-exchange standards and a governance structure.
